versions.subject: feat: add two new rules
versions.detection:
selection_main:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|contains: '\Environment\'
selection_details:
    Details:
        - 'powershell'
        - 'pwsh'
    Details|contains:
        # Add more suspicious strings in env variables below
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - 'C:\Users\Public\'
        # Base64 MZ Header
        - 'TVqQAAMAAAAEAAAA' # MZ..........
        - 'TVpQAAIAAAAEAA8A'

        - 'SQBuAHYAbwBrAGUALQ'
        - 'kAbgB2AG8AawBlAC0A'
        - 'JAG4AdgBvAGsAZQAtA'
condition: all of selection_*
